relevance_note: Case series of three girls with GFAP variants: "the authors report 3 genetically confirmed Alexander disease cases".
method_note: Read by hand; no tables in the paper, so no script transcription (a script only assembled and checked the JSON). Labels: the text uses 'Patient 1-3' (headings 'Case 1-3'). Each variant is called 'de novo' but the paper does not describe parental testing, so inheritance is 'not reported' (rule 8) and parental_testing_statement is 'not reported'. Zygosity is stated only for Patient 1 ('heterozygous'); the intro's general 'dominant missense mutations' is not used for any person's zygosity or variant type. Variants recorded exactly as printed; possible internal inconsistency: 'c.729 C>T, p.R239C' and 'c. 270 A>G, p. K86E' have cDNA positions that do not fall in the stated codons (c.729 would be codon 243, c.270 codon 90), and C>T at c.729 is not consistent with an amino-acid change at codon 239; not corrected. Patient 1's brain MRI at age 17 months was 'reportedly normal' (recorded as 'abnormal brain MRI' excluded at that age; it excludes nothing more specific); later MRI at 13 years abnormal - different time points, not a contradiction. Patient 1 'nonenhancing FLAIR signal increase surrounding the frontal horns' was not mapped to the checklist 'periventricular rim'. Patient 3's lesion 'did not enhance with gadolinium' is narrower than the checklist item 'contrast enhancement on MRI', which stays not reported. Palatal myoclonus (Patient 2) mapped to checklist 'palatal tremor'; obstructive sleep apnea (Patient 2) mapped to autonomic dysfunction (sleep apnea listed); Patient 3's 'central apnea' and GERD were not mapped. Bulbar dysfunction not mapped to dysphagia or dysarthria. Patient 2's white matter lesions were seen on CT, not MRI; mapped to 'cerebral white matter abnormality'. 'Typical' MRI statements for Patients 2 and 3 were not expanded into specific checklist items. is_proband null (three unrelated cases, no proband wording); cites_prior_report_of_same_patients null (not stated); vital status not stated explicitly.
